clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Thran Khorman calls young dwarven warriors to Anvilmar. The Simple Rune is an inscribed stone token that directs recruits to seek instruction from their warrior trainer.

The Simple Rune marks the start of a recruit’s training. Thran Khorman gives the inscribed stone to promising young fighters who have begun clearing threats from Coldridge Valley. Its marks are a formal summons, not a magical charm. A recruit who reads it is expected to report to Thran inside Anvilmar, where the warrior trainer teaches basic combat and offers practical advice for surviving Dun Morogh’s hostile wilds.
